products.name: Amplify mCLASS
products.note: Verified in the research for The AI Ready School. AI: Automatic scoring; no speech recognition. Use: DIBELS 8 early literacy screening. Who: Teachers, students K to 6. Student age: School license. Privacy: Signed Texas student data privacy agreement (TX-NDPA) with Midway ISD, 2025, in the SDPC registry. Price: $9 per student for one year or $7 multi-year (California filing); Lectura add-on $5; DIBELS Data System alternative $1 per student plus $200 setup.
